notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Endbringer.
Endbringer does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Endbringer's first ability by tapping it, targeting any creature.
Horobi triggers, destroying that creature.
When the creature dies, Endbringer triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.
 You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.
